# cargo-registry

Crates Cargo downloaded. Cargo downloads them again when a build needs them.

**Name:** Cargo registry · **Category:** Package caches · **Status:** stable · **Systems:** macOS, Linux, Windows

Upstream docs: <https://doc.rust-lang.org/cargo/guide/cargo-home.html>

**Detected when** one of `{cargo_home}/registry`, `{cargo_home}/git` exists.

## Paths

Resolved in this order: the tool's own command, then the environment variable, then the system default.

- `{cargo_home}`: `$CARGO_HOME` → default `~/.cargo`

## Locations

| Path | Item | Safety | Why | Actions |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `{cargo_home}/registry/cache` | Cargo downloaded crates | Safe | This is a download cache; it is fetched again when needed (`REDOWNLOADABLE`) | `quarantine` |
| `{cargo_home}/registry/src` | Cargo unpacked crate sources | Safe | This is a download cache; it is fetched again when needed (`REDOWNLOADABLE`) | `quarantine` |
| `{cargo_home}/git/checkouts` | Cargo git checkouts | Safe | This is a download cache; it is fetched again when needed (`REDOWNLOADABLE`) | `quarantine` |
| `{cargo_home}/git/db` | Cargo git databases | Safe | This is a download cache; it is fetched again when needed (`REDOWNLOADABLE`) | `quarantine` |

## In use

Items are Keep while one of these runs: `cargo`.
